title: Split user and developer installation modes
measurement_note: Timing was reconstructed after web-first intake; phase durations are approximate.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Checked official pip, Python packaging, npm, and Vercel docs.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.bottleneck_notes: Added REQ-WS-049 and bilingual spec/change/review records.

phases.label: Registry and CLI implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Added install mode registry, CLI commands, tests, docs, workflow, prompt, and memory bootstrap links.

phases.label: History and evaluation records
phases.bottleneck_notes: Included web records, research note, plan, trace, work summary, grounding, evaluator input, and timing.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Reserved for CLI, tests, config contract, memory bootstrap, audits, grounding, evaluator, work timer, and diff checks.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The main cost is wiring a new durable setup concept across config, CLI, docs, memory, and governance records.
improvement_candidates: Generate install mode docs from the registry if the command list grows.
Add a smoke-test runner for selected install profiles after real setup usage accumulates.
